title: Jared Verse not done with Seahawks rivalry

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jared Verse not done with Seahawks rivalry
sources.description: Jared Verse’s final words to his former Rams teammates? “Beat the Seahawks.” In an interview with Browns media last week, Verse said that his last message after he was traded to Cleveland was that he wanted his old teammates to beat Seattle at every opportunity. You can trade the man out of the rivalry, but […]
